title: AlignmentResult
description: Full time-warp alignment between two Signals (Task 4/6). Owned by Person C (signal-processing/sync/). Consumed by Person A (routing/mix delivery) and Person B (mode owners displaying/using synced audio). Breaking changes require a version bump and review from A and B before merging.

signal_ids.description: The Signal IDs being aligned. Exactly 2 for Task 4 (pairwise); up to 4 for Task 6 (group).

reference_signal_id.description: The Signal ID all others are warped relative to (Task 4: the second signal warped onto the first; Task 6: the group's chosen/reassigned anchor, e.g. Performance mode's lead).

warp_path.description: For pairwise (Task 4): a list of [reference_frame_idx, other_frame_idx] pairs in ascending order, the DTW warp path over frame-level features (not a single constant offset — required for tempo-drift handling). For group (Task 6): an object keyed by signal_id with its own warp path against reference_signal_id.

confidence.description: Alignment quality estimate, 0 (poor) to 1 (excellent). For method=dtw_chroma this is derived from DTW path cost (content match quality). For method=timestamp_offset it instead reflects trust in the shared room clock, since there's no melodic content to verify against -- it cannot detect relative tempo drift the way dtw_chroma can.

hop_length_ms.description: Time resolution of one frame step in warp_path, in milliseconds.

method.description: Alignment algorithm used. dtw_chroma: DTW over chroma features, tracks tempo drift, requires the two signals to share melodic/harmonic content. timestamp_offset: a constant offset derived from each Signal's captured start_time on the shared room clock (Task 1) -- the fallback when dtw_chroma's confidence is too low to trust, e.g. the two performers are singing/playing different material rather than the same piece.

streaming.description: True if produced by the incremental/windowed streaming aligner (partial, updated on a rolling buffer); false if produced by the batch aligner on complete closed Signals.
